clue.text: Line is evident in regressive dance like the mazurka

going backwards, so the dance word is read from right to left

parts.note: to hop is to dance or skip about

explanation.surface: A dance-floor line forms during a backwards-moving folk dance.
explanation.walkthrough: 'regressive' turns HOP into POH; 'evident in' places L and IS inside it, between PO and H.
explanation.definitionFit: The mazurka is a folk dance from Poland, so it can be described with the national adjective.

clue.text: In hideaway, poet worked with relish

explanation.surface: A poet busily writing with gusto in a secret refuge.

explanation.definitionFit: A concealed chamber for a fugitive priest is a hiding place.

clue.text: Language displayed by learner in game

parts.note: L is for learner, as on British learner-driver plates
taken as written
Go is a Japanese board game

explanation.surface: Jargon that a beginner shows while playing.
explanation.definitionFit: Lingo is informal for a language or jargon, a colloquial synonym.

clue.text: Apologising after involving church in witchcraft

indicators.note: the apology word wraps round the church letters

parts.note: saying sorry is apologising
CE is the Church of England

explanation.surface: Someone apologises after drawing the church into a witchcraft affair.
explanation.definitionFit: Sorcery is the use of magic, the same as witchcraft.

clue.text: Way of handling a very soft fag-end

explanation.surface: Someone describes their style of dealing with a gently stubbed-out cigarette butt.

clue.text: Listened to quiet bit

indicators.note: heard by ear, so the word is taken by its sound

parts.note: peace means quiet or calm

explanation.surface: Someone heard a gentle passage of music.
explanation.definitionFit: A portion or fragment of something is a bit of it.

clue.text: Pianist identified with scale?

explanation.surface: A pianist famous for playing scales.
explanation.definitionFit: The name belongs both to a famous Soviet pianist and to the seismic magnitude scale.

clue.text: Pushy type, a striver, I fancy

indicators.note: fancy as an anagram signal: elaborate or rearranged

explanation.surface: Someone imagining they are an ambitious social climber.
explanation.definitionFit: A social climber or upstart is an ambitious, thrusting person.

clue.text: In large numbers, parasites prey on one

definitions.meaning: a ... of things is a great many of them

explanation.surface: Swarms of parasites feeding on a single victim.

clue.text: Crime not disrupted with radio link

indicators.note: broken up, so the letters are rearranged

clue.text: One wouldn't know if one was afflicted by this

definitions.text: One wouldn't know if one was afflicted by this

parts.words: One wouldn't know if one was afflicted by this
parts.note: reads like a silent disease, but the condition is simply not knowing, so sufferers by definition are unaware of it

explanation.surface: A warning about an illness with no detectable symptoms.
explanation.definitionFit: Lack of knowledge is a state whose sufferers, being uninformed, cannot be aware of it.

clue.text: Police capturing leader of robber band

indicators.note: the first letter of the following word is taken

clue.text: Someone shopping those who aren't?

explanation.surface: A puzzle about a customer and other people who are not customers.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Shopping' means 'turning in to the police' (British slang), so the person shops those who are not shopping but stealing.
explanation.definitionFit: A plain-clothes security officer in a retail outlet catches shoplifters and reports them.

clue.text: Linked, as in index-linked?

clue.text: Consequence of stone in fodder crop is not thought through

parts.note: hay is dried grass grown as animal fodder
st is the abbreviation for stone, the British weight of 14 pounds

explanation.definitionFit: A rash decision made too quickly has not been properly considered.

clue.text: Space is quickly taken up to secure advantage in battle

indicators.note: the reversed word holds the advantage word inside it
in a down clue taken up means read from the bottom, so the space word goes backwards

parts.note: room means space, and 'is' contracts to an S
an edge is an advantage

clue.text: Snapped only under pressure?

explanation.definitionFit: A government minister is a senior politician.

clue.text: Behold maidens besotted-with one such?

indicators.note: infatuated or befuddled, so the letters are jumbled

explanation.surface: Look at those young women, infatuated with a smooth charmer.
explanation.walkthrough: 'besotted' rearranges MAIDENS into DIESMAN; 'one such' points back to the man the besotted maidens are besotted with.
explanation.definitionFit: A womaniser is precisely the type that infatuated young women are smitten with.

clue.text: Venus wickedly ensnaring one with love and with jealousy

indicators.note: the jumbled goddess word traps the other letters
behaving wickedly here means the letters go astray

parts.note: I is the Roman numeral one
love is zero in tennis, written as O

explanation.surface: The goddess of love wickedly trapping someone, consumed by jealousy.
explanation.walkthrough: 'wickedly' rearranges VENUS into ENVUS; 'ensnaring' puts IO inside it, after ENV.
explanation.definitionFit: Envious describes someone filled with jealousy.

clue.text: Insect starts to climb hardwood tree

parts.note: a bee is an insect

indicators.note: the opening letters of the next two words are taken

clue.text: Supporter, English, to spoil games venue

parts.note: a bra is a supporting undergarment
to mar is to spoil

explanation.surface: A fan, an Englishman, sets out to ruin a sports ground.
explanation.walkthrough: BRAEMAR is the Scottish village famous for its Highland Games, attended by the royal family.
explanation.definitionFit: This Aberdeenshire village hosts the famous annual Highland Gathering of traditional sports.

clue.text: Position of cross after Mass, say, where one stops in transport?

parts.note: Mass is an example of a church service

clue.text: Councillor accepting plan outlawing a drink

banning the letter, so it is removed

parts.note: an idea is a plan

explanation.definitionFit: Fermented apple juice is an alcoholic drink.

clue.text: Key material presumed to be found in certain graveyard?

definitions.text: presumed to be found in certain graveyard?
definitions.meaning: the legendary elephants' graveyard is supposed to be full of tusks

clue.text: Vegetable identified in second course?

parts.note: pud, short for pudding, is the dessert course of a British meal

explanation.surface: A potato appears in the second course of a meal.

only the first half of the word is kept

parts.note: to dream is to imagine

explanation.surface: Picture a gravy jug, and ask whether it counts as a serving dish.

clue.text: Is love in Irish city of little value?

indicators.note: these letters go inside the city name

taken as written
love is zero in tennis, written as O

clue.text: Tatty chap, always inside
